discussion_comments.comment_body: Addressed in 74f6a0c4dd. Discovery now invokes the interactive login shell with -ilc, including .zshrc/.bashrc PATH setup. It tolerates startup output when selecting an absolute CLI path and surfaces shell discovery failures instead of silently installing a second CLI. Added a macOS regression test with PATH configured only in .zshrc; the Rust suite passes.
i tried it. taskbar icon persists as midnight no matter what i pick. tried restarting the app - still the default.
Hmm, that's weird, works for me...

Confirmed. Windows owns the pinned taskbar and task-group icon through the installed shortcut, so the runtime `WM_SETICON` override could not make this reliable across Windows configurations. I removed that unsupported path and its duplicate ICO resources. The picker now promises the supported Windows surface—the System tray—while the running window and Alt+Tab icon still update through Tauri.
